interpretations.scope_boundary: In scope: add a single new Notification-event hook that surfaces preflight's already-detected, non-blocking framework-integrity conditions (registration rot, dead-gate liveness, config/stack drift) as an actual notification, registered via hooks.json and wired through the installer + a behavioral test. Boundary: it only re-surfaces conditions other hooks ALREADY compute — it adds no new detection logic, blocks nothing, and is not about review-pipeline or PR/Slack/email user-alerting.
surfaces_in_scope: hooks/ — new `notify` hook file (bash), self-resolving like the others
hooks/hooks.json — register the hook under a `Notification` event matcher (the SINGLE source merged into consumer settings.json)
lib/heartbeat.sh — reuse `_check_heartbeat_fresh` for the dead-gate liveness condition (read-only consumer)
tests/behavioral/ — new behavioral test piping crafted stdin and asserting the hook emits the notification (or stays silent when clean), wired into tests/run-all-tests.sh
hooks/run-hook.cmd path — confirm the new hook dispatches through the existing Windows shim
surfaces_out_of_scope: No new gate / no blocking behavior (exit 2) — notifications are advisory, fail-open by design
No new detection logic — does not compute drift/registration/liveness itself; reuses what session-start and drift-detector already derive
No external delivery channels (Slack, email, webhooks, desktop toast integrations beyond Claude Code's Notification mechanism)
No changes to the fix-and-close / review pipeline or PR-status alerting
Not touching preflight-verify.sh integrity reporting or the manifest schema beyond the file naturally landing in the hooks manifest
No config-schema additions (no notification-preferences config block) for the first cut
interpretations.core_behavior: A new advisory `Notification`-event hook re-surfaces preflight's already-detected framework-integrity warnings (registration rot, stale/dead-gate heartbeats, config/stack drift) as a notification so they aren't lost when buried in SessionStart additionalContext — emitting a notification only when a condition is present and staying silent (fail-open) otherwise.

interpretations.scope_boundary: In scope: surface a human-facing notification when a preflight gate blocks an action (exit 2) or hits a stop/decision point, emitted through the existing Claude Code hook output channel (stderr message / SessionStart additionalContext). Boundary: it is a notification-emission layer inside the framework's own gates/hooks, NOT an external delivery integration and NOT a new gate.
surfaces_in_scope: hooks/ gates that exit 2 (pre-push-gate-check, bootstrap-write-gate, coupled-edit-gate, adjudication-output-gate, behavioral-contract-gate, rubric-validity-gate) — emit a structured notification message on block
hooks/session-start — surface pending/blocked-gate notifications as additionalContext on session resume (reusing the existing REG_WARN/HB_WARN warning pattern)
lib/ — a small shared notify.sh helper that formats the notification consistently, sourced by gates (parallel to lib/heartbeat.sh)
defaults/config-template.json — an opt-in 'notify' config block (enabled flag, which events) read by the helper
surfaces_out_of_scope: External delivery channels: Slack, email, SMS, webhooks, OS desktop toast/notify-send/PowerShell pop-ups
Claude Code's native 'Notification' hook event — not adding a new hookEventName registration
Notifications for a CONSUMER application's runtime (this is the framework source, not a migrated service)
A new PreToolUse gate or any blocking behavior — notifications are informational, never change a gate's exit code
Async/background daemons, polling timers, or persistent notification queues beyond a HEAD-fresh evidence-style marker
Re-plumbing the installer manifest beyond registering the new lib/notify.sh surface if one is added
interpretations.core_behavior: When a preflight gate decides to block (exit 2), it emits a clear, structured human-facing notification (what was blocked, which gate, why, and what clears it) through the existing hook stderr/context output path, and any unacknowledged block is re-surfaced as additionalContext at the next SessionStart.

surfaces_in_scope: hooks/run-hook.cmd Windows shim dispatch for the new hook name
tools/preflight-install.sh installed.lock manifest and tools/preflight-verify.sh touched in concert if the surface set changes
surfaces_out_of_scope: external transports email Slack webhooks desktop toast
any new PreToolUse gate or change to existing gate block/allow logic
user-facing notification preferences schema in config-template.json
refactoring the existing REG_WARN and HB_WARN additionalContext warnings in session-start
skills agents docs prose beyond an honesty label that delivery is harness-level not guaranteed
plugin.json .claude-plugin WIP placeholder the installer never reads
interpretations.scope_boundary: In scope is one new framework-emitted notification path: a Notification-event hook registered in hooks.json that surfaces framework alerts through the Claude Code harness. The boundary stops at the harness handing off the message; no external transport, no user config schema, no new gate logic.
interpretations.core_behavior: On a Claude Code Notification harness event the new hooks/notify script reads stdin, formats a framework-context message reusing the additionalContext emission pattern already used for registration and liveness warnings, and emits it so the agent or operator sees framework alerts at notification time.

interpretations.scope_boundary: In scope: add a Claude Code Notification-event (and Stop-event) hook to the preflight framework source so the harness emits a user-facing notification when a mechanical gate blocks a push or a review loop stops/completes, registered via hooks.json and shipped by the installer. Boundary: it is a passive, fail-open notify side-channel only — it changes NO gate decision, blocks nothing, and adds no new config-required surface beyond an optional toggle.
surfaces_in_scope: hooks/notify (new hook script, run via run-hook.cmd shim, fail-open like a passive probe)
hooks/hooks.json (add Notification and Stop event blocks — the single registration source the installer jq-merges into consumer settings.json)
tests/behavioral/ + tests/run-all-tests.sh (new behavioral test: feed crafted notification/stop JSON to the hook, assert exit 0 and that the notify message is emitted)
defaults/config-template.json (optional notify on/off toggle, defaulting to a safe value)
FRAMEWORK.md / relevant hooks doc (honesty-label the notify as passive/fail-open, not a gate)
surfaces_out_of_scope: The mechanical gate logic itself (pre-push-gate, coupled-edit-gate, etc.) — notifications observe, they never alter a block/allow decision
Any new always-on hard dependency (no required daemon, no network/webhook integration like Slack/email — purely local OS/terminal notification via available channel, degrading silently if absent)
Email/Slack/SMS/web-push delivery or a notification inbox/persistence store
Generic web/app notification UI — this is a Bash+Markdown CLI harness, not a web app, so no frontend/toast component
preflight-install.sh / preflight-verify.sh / installed.lock internals — they auto-discover the hooks/ surface and read hooks.json, so no code edit there beyond what the new files imply
Changing iteration caps, evidence files, or .preflight/gate/ semantics
interpretations.core_behavior: When the Claude Code Notification (or Stop) event fires — e.g. a gate blocked a push or the review loop finished/stopped — a new fail-open hooks/notify script emits a user-facing local notification, observing harness state without ever altering any gate decision.
